BrochureContent.Content:
David Ross Estate Agents, your local property experts, are delighted to present No. 33 Loreto Crescent. This fine 3 bed 2 bath terraced house located in the quiet residential area of Rathfarnam is sure to catch the eye of any discerning purchaser. 

Number 33 is surrounded by a host of local amenities to include many shops, parks, sports facilities, primary and secondary schools. It is also right beside Nutgrove Shopping Centre which is a thriving and popular spot.

Downstairs briefly comprises a warm entrance hallway with a good sized front reception room just off this. Towards the rear you have a fully fitted kitchen alongside a convenient downstairs bathroom.

To the rear you have a fantastic back garden. Both private and spacious this makes for the perfect space for enjoying those long summer days with family and friends.

Upstairs consists of three bedrooms, one large double to the rear and a double alongside a single bedroom to the front aspect. A fully tiled family bathroom with shower facilities completes the first floor.

This property benefits from great public transport links with several bus routes running to and from the City Centre and beyond. The M50 motorway is also only a short drive away.

This fantastic property is not one to be missed so early viewing would be recommended to see everything this home has to offer.
Viewing by appointment only.

Features:
- Terraced
- Great condition
- Prime location
- Large back garden
